description: Symptom -> issue/cluster retrieval checks plus behavioral checks for the confusable clusters. Retrieval cases are data-testable via run_eval.py. Behavioral cases require the live model + Phase 1 cultivation prompt.

retrieval_cases.query: my bottom leaves are going yellow and a couple dropped off
yellow between the veins on the lower leaves but the veins are still green
everything is yellowing and spotting even though I feed regularly and it keeps getting worse
leaves are yellowing near the end of flower and the buds look about done, should I worry
lower leaves yellowing, is this a feeding problem or the pH
my plant is drooping and I'm not sure why
retrieval_cases.note: bare droop -> over vs under look identical; must surface both and ask

retrieval_cases.query: leaves drooping and the soil is still soggy and the pot feels heavy
drooping and the pot feels really light and the medium is bone dry
the roots are brown and slimy and it smells bad and it's wilting
leaves curling up at the edges like a taco when the tent gets hot
silvery streaks on the leaves with tiny black specks next to them
tiny pale dots all over the leaves and some fine webbing between branches
tiny speckled marks and dots on my leaves, can't tell if it's bugs or a deficiency
the air in my grow is really dry and leaf edges are crisping but my feeding and pH are dialed
white powdery stuff on my leaves that looks like flour and wipes off
white frosty sparkly crystals all over my buds, is this mold
not sure if the white on my buds is mildew or the good sparkly stuff
I opened a bud and the inside is grey and mushy
my buds are growing spiky towers sticking up near the light
there are little yellow banana things poking out of my buds
light has been getting into my tent during the dark period
burnt crispy brown tips on a bunch of leaves all over the plant
dark green shiny leaves and the tips are clawing under like talons
brown spots on the new top leaves and the new growth is twisted and deformed
the edges of my older lower leaves look scorched and burnt at the margins
my newest top leaves went bright pale yellow with greener veins
my plant in veg is getting tall and stretchy with big gaps between the leaves
my plant shot up and nearly doubled right after I flipped it to 12/12
little black flies crawling around the surface of the soil and flying up when I water
clusters of tiny bugs on my stems and new growth and the leaves are sticky
my seedling fell over and the stem is pinched and thin right at the soil line
my seeds just won't sprout, nothing is happening
my seedling is barely growing after a week, is it okay
my plant drooped and wilted right after I repotted it into a bigger container
how do I know when to chop, are my buds ready to harvest
my dried buds smell like hay and fresh cut grass and the smoke is harsh

behavioral_cases.query: my plant is drooping, what's wrong
behavioral_cases.note: over/under water look identical; must ask about medium/pot weight before diagnosing

behavioral_cases.query: there's white stuff on my buds, is it ruined
behavioral_cases.note: must not 'diagnose' mold on a healthy frosty plant; lead with the loupe check

behavioral_cases.query: lower leaves yellowing, should I add more nutes
behavioral_cases.note: must raise pH/lockout before telling them to feed more

behavioral_cases.query: I found a couple silvery marks on some leaves
behavioral_cases.note: should ask about frass/webbing under a loupe rather than guess the pest

behavioral_cases.query: I think I have bud rot
behavioral_cases.note: escalate=true: careful answer AND flag consumption safety / seriousness
